AWS us-east-1. A14, A15, A17, A18." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="35" width="3120" x="40" y="75" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="band1_container" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f8fc;strokeColor=#61788d;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#172b4d;fontSize=18;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=15;" value="TELEMETRY INGESTION PIPELINE | left-to-right flow: farm nodes to persistence, evaluation &amp; crop alert (A14, A17, B09)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="540" width="3120" x="40" y="125" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b1_s1_card" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#8da2b5;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172b4d;fontSize=13.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=12;" value="<b><font size="4" color="#102a43">1. Field Sensor Nodes &amp; Bearers</font></b><br/><font color="#0b69a3"><b>Triggers &amp; Exit Protocols (A14, Connectivity sec 4)</b></font><br/><br/>• <b>Two Sensor Node Classes per Farm:</b><br/> - <i>Crop node:</i> 6 readings/day (temp, humidity, pH, NPK)<br/> - <i>Drying node:</i> 24 readings/day while drying lot is open<br/><br/>• <b>Secure Protocol &amp; Device Identity (mTLS, D06):</b><br/> - MQTT over TLS 1.2+ on port 8883 (or 443 with ALPN)<br/> - Unique per-node X.509 client certificate from CSR (ASM-010)<br/> - Zero static shared keys; operational revocation in IoT Core<br/><br/>• <b>Store-and-Forward Buffer (No-Signal Resilience):</b><br/> - Encrypted non-volatile ring buffer (&gt;= 24 hours / 6 readings)<br/> - On reconnect: live reading first, then drains oldest first<br/> - <code>PUBACK</code> acknowledgement releases reading from buffer<br/><br/>• <b>Bearers:</b> LTE multi-network SIM; satellite for no-coverage (ASM-073)<br/>• <b>Path:</b> Direct to IoT Core; bypasses centers and VPC (CL-TEL-04)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="465" width="490" x="70" y="175" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b1_s2_card" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#8da2b5;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172b4d;fontSize=13.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=12;" value="<b><font size="4" color="#102a43">2. Regional Ingestion &amp; Topic Rule</font></b><br/><font color="#0b69a3"><b>AWS IoT Core &amp; Pattern Module (ADR-003, B09)</b></font><br/><br/>• <b>AWS IoT Core Regional Endpoint (us-east-1):</b><br/> - Public ATS endpoint; terminates mTLS with device certificates<br/> - Validates client certificates against IoT Thing Registry<br/> - Topic: <code>aroma/telemetry/&lt;department&gt;/&lt;farm&gt;/&lt;node&gt;</code><br/><br/>• <b>Topic Rule (B09 Telemetry Pattern Module):</b><br/> - SQL: <code>SELECT *, timestamp() AS received_at FROM 'aroma/telemetry/#'</code><br/> - Appends metadata: cert principal, client ID, source IP, timestamps<br/><br/>• <b>Two Direct Rule Actions:</b><br/> 1. <i>DynamoDB Action:</i> Conditional put directly to <code>telemetry</code> table<br/> 2. <i>SQS Action:</i> Enqueues reading reference to <code>threshold_queue</code><br/><br/>• <b>Rule Error Action (Failure Path):</b><br/> - Failed deliveries routed to SQS Error Queue for redrive (ASM-161)<br/> - Rejected connection/publish logged to <code>AWSIotLogsV2</code> at ERROR" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="465" width="490" x="700" y="175" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="badge_D09" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dcebf7;strokeColor=#52708a;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#102a43;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" value="D09" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="26" width="52" x="1125" y="185" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b1_s3_card" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#8da2b5;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172b4d;fontSize=13.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=12;" value="<b><font size="4" color="#102a43">3. Primary Storage Target</font></b><br/><font color="#0b69a3"><b>Amazon DynamoDB Telemetry Store</b></font><br/><br/>• <b>Target Table:</b> <code>telemetry</code> (DynamoDB on-demand mode)<br/>• <b>Primary Keys:</b><br/> - Partition Key: <code>node_id</code> (String)<br/> - Sort Key: <code>timestamp</code> (Number, epoch milliseconds)<br/><br/>• <b>Encryption &amp; Protection (D06):</b><br/> - Customer-managed KMS key (<code>telemetry</code> key)<br/> - Deletion protection: <code>prevent_destroy = true</code> in Terraform<br/> - Point-in-Time Recovery (PITR) enabled for continuous backups<br/><br/>• <b>Retention &amp; Compliance:</b><br/> - 5-year retention enforced automatically by TTL attribute<br/> - Audited Event 3: Stores cert principal, source IP, receive time (ASM-067)<br/><br/>• <b>Scale:</b> 3,600 readings/day peak; 3,600/min drain surge resilience" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="465" width="490" x="1330" y="175" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b1_s4_card" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#8da2b5;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172b4d;fontSize=13.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=12;" value="<b><font size="4" color="#102a43">4. Threshold Evaluation &amp; Alerts</font></b><br/><font color="#0b69a3"><b>Event-Driven Processing (A14, A17)</b></font><br/><br/>• <b>Buffer Queue:</b> SQS <code>threshold_queue</code> (visibility timeout 300s)<br/><br/>• <b>Threshold Function (AWS Lambda, live alias):</b><br/> - Event Source Mapping with batch size 10 items<br/> - Evaluates reading against versioned <code>thresholds</code> DynamoDB table<br/> - <b>Versioning Rule:</b> Evaluated against threshold in force at<br/> reading's <i>original timestamp</i>, not receive time (ASM-138)<br/> - Idempotent conditional write prevents duplicate evaluations<br/><br/>• <b>Episode Coalescing &amp; Case Opening:</b><br/> - Alerts open <i>once per episode</i> (node, variable), NOT per reading<br/> - Persists <code>crop_alert_raised</code> to <code>cases</code> table; switches to precision mode<br/><br/>• <b>Dual-Channel Farmer Notification Dispatch:</b><br/> - Publishes to KMS-encrypted SNS <code>alert_topic</code><br/> - Lambda <code>notification_dispatcher</code> sends App Push &amp; SMS<br/> - <b>Target:</b> Delivered &lt; 5 minutes for live reading (ASM-075)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="465" width="490" x="1960" y="175" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b1_s5_card" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#8da2b5;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172b4d;fontSize=13.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=12;" value="<b><font size="4" color="#102a43">5. Failure Paths &amp; Rollback</font></b><br/><font color="#0b69a3"><b>Resilience &amp; Correction (A18 sec 6, sec 10)</b></font><br/><br/>• <b>Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ) &amp; Error Recovery:</b><br/> - <code>threshold_dlq</code> captures failures after 5 attempts with backoff<br/> - Unhandled IoT rule messages held in <code>aroma-telemetry-error-queue</code><br/> - Operator redrives messages without redeployment after fix<br/><br/>• <b>CloudWatch Observability Hooks &amp; Alarms:</b><br/> - <code>&lt;prefix&gt;-pdn-alarm-threshold-errors</code> &amp; throttles on alias<br/> - <code>&lt;prefix&gt;-pdn-alarm-threshold-dlq-age</code> &gt; 0<br/> - <code>ReadingNotPersisted</code> metric &amp; <code>AWSIotLogsV2</code> error count<br/><br/>• <b>CodeDeploy Canary Rollback (&lt; 10 min target):</b><br/> - Alarms during 10% canary automatically revert alias to previous version<br/><br/>• <b>Forward Correction (What CANNOT be rolled back):</b><br/> - <i>Stored wrong attributes:</i> Audited batch correction job<br/> - <i>Sent alerts / SMS:</i> Dispatched correction notice on same channels<br/> - <i>Revoked certificates:</i> Final action; re-enroll node with new CSR" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="465" width="490" x="2590" y="175" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="band2_container" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f8fc;strokeColor=#61788d;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#172b4d;fontSize=18;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=15;" value="FLIGHT-OBJECT RECEPTION PIPELINE | left-to-right flow: ground station to S3, EventBridge, Bedrock inference &amp; results (A15, A17, B10)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="540" width="3120" x="40" y="690" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b2_s1_card" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#8da2b5;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172b4d;fontSize=13.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=12;" value="<b><font size="4" color="#102a43">1. Ground Station Upload &amp; Ingress</font></b><br/><font color="#0b69a3"><b>Contracted Drone Operator (ADR-002, A15, D04)</b></font><br/><br/>• <b>Actor &amp; Location:</b><br/> - Contracted certified commercial drone operator (ADR-002)<br/> - Collection center Soporte zone (IP <code>10.4x.2.10</code>, VLAN 102)<br/> - Or public link at municipal seat<br/><br/>• <b>Upload Authorization (ASM-093):</b><br/> - 15-minute S3 pre-signed upload URLs generated by API role<br/> - Pre-signed URLs bound strictly to flight prefix and SHA-256 checksums<br/><br/>• <b>Network Ingress Endpoints (Collection Center, D04):</b><br/> - Ground station (10.4x.2.10) -&gt; Center Firewall -&gt; IPsec VPN tunnel -&gt;<br/> AWS Transit Gateway (D05) -&gt; <code>object_storage</code> S3 interface endpoint<br/> - <i>Note: <code>drone_object_ingress</code> tier is RESERVED (ASM-140); active path<br/> uses <code>object_storage</code> and <code>application</code> private interface endpoints</i><br/><br/>• <b>Local Ground Station Buffer:</b><br/> - Operator encrypted storage holds photos and records while offline<br/> - Deleted ONLY upon platform persistence receipt (A15 sec 7)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="465" width="490" x="70" y="740" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="badge_D04" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dcebf7;strokeColor=#52708a;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#102a43;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" value="D04" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="26" width="52" x="495" y="750" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b2_s2_card" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#8da2b5;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172b4d;fontSize=13.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=12;" value="<b><font size="4" color="#102a43">2. S3 Drone Object Bucket &amp; Notifications</font></b><br/><font color="#0b69a3"><b>Object Ingestion &amp; Audit Trail (A15, D06)</b></font><br/><br/>• <b>Target Bucket:</b> <code>aroma-&lt;env&gt;-drone-objects</code> (us-east-1)<br/>• <b>Security &amp; Encryption Controls (CL-DRN-03, D06):</b><br/> - S3 Block Public Access enabled across all four dimensions<br/> - S3 Object Versioning enabled (protects against overwrites/deletions)<br/> - Customer-managed KMS key (<code>objects</code> key)<br/> - 5-year retention enforced by lifecycle rules<br/><br/>• <b>Two-Phase Upload Sequence:</b><br/> 1. <i>Flight objects uploaded:</i> Orthomosaics, multispectral photos,<br/> GPX flight tracks, telemetry logs<br/> 2. <i>Flight manifest uploaded:</i> JSON manifest detailing all files, checksums,<br/> mission ID, timestamps, sensor calibration data<br/><br/>• <b>S3 Event Notification Trigger:</b><br/> - <code>s3:ObjectCreated:*</code> on manifest path invokes Lambda <code>reception</code> function<br/><br/>• <b>CloudTrail S3 Data Events (Audited Event 4, ASM-067):</b><br/> - Logs <code>PutObject</code> &amp; <code>CompleteMultipartUpload</code> to audit trail in Security Account" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="465" width="490" x="700" y="740" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b2_s3_card" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#8da2b5;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172b4d;fontSize=13.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=12;" value="<b><font size="4" color="#102a43">3. Reception Function &amp; Screening</font></b><br/><font color="#0b69a3"><b>Validation, Privacy &amp; Receipts (A15, A17)</b></font><br/><br/>• <b>AWS Lambda Reception Function (live alias):</b><br/> - Invoked via S3 Event Notification upon manifest arrival<br/><br/>• <b>Four Strict Validation Gates:</b><br/> 1. <b>Manifest Verification:</b> Validates SHA-256 hashes against active grant<br/> 2. <b>Quarantine Gate:</b> Any object outside grant or with invalid checksum<br/> moved immediately to <code>quarantine/</code> prefix<br/> 3. <b>Privacy Screening (ASM-164, ASM-165):</b><br/> - Images screened on ground station for human presence before upload<br/> - Reception function moves flagged objects to <code>restricted/person/</code><br/> - Encrypted under customer-managed <code>restricted</code> KMS key<br/> - <i>Only screened crop images can ever leave Colombia to Bedrock!</i><br/> 4. <b>Persistence Receipt:</b> Emitted to ground station once all objects and<br/> manifest are verified and linked (<code>record_persisted</code>)<br/><br/>• <b>Mission Store Update:</b><br/> - Writes flight record, mission state (<code>record_persisted</code>), and polygon<br/> versions to DynamoDB <code>missions</code> table (<code>records</code> key, 5 years)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="465" width="490" x="1330" y="740" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b2_s4_card" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#8da2b5;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172b4d;fontSize=13.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=12;" value="<b><font size="4" color="#102a43">4. EventBridge Routing &amp; Bedrock</font></b><br/><font color="#0b69a3"><b>Event-Driven Inference Pattern (A17, B10)</b></font><br/><br/>• <b>Event Decoupling Architecture:</b><br/> - DynamoDB Streams captures <code>record_persisted</code><br/> - EventBridge Pipe routes events to custom <code>aroma-drone-bus</code><br/><br/>• <b>Four Mission-Type Rules &amp; SQS Queues:</b><br/> 1. <i>Delimitation:</i> Rule -&gt; SQS -&gt; Delimitation Lambda (activates polygon)<br/> 2. <i>Confirmation:</i> Rule -&gt; <code>infconfirmqueue</code> (DLQ: <code>infconfirmdlq</code>) -&gt; Lambda<br/> 3. <i>Estimation:</i> Rule -&gt; <code>infestimatequeue</code> (DLQ: <code>infestimatedlq</code>) -&gt; Lambda<br/> 4. <i>Verification:</i> Rule -&gt; <code>infverificationqueue</code> (DLQ: <code>infverificationdlq</code>) -&gt; Lambda<br/><br/>• <b>Amazon Bedrock Inference (us-east-1):</b><br/> - Calls vision foundation model (Amazon Nova Pro) by model ID<br/> - Packages embed zero-shot prompt &amp; schema (<code>prompt_version</code>, ASM-179)<br/> - Persists result: timestamp, confidence, <code>function_version</code>, source object<br/><br/>• <b>Strict Human Governance (ADR-002, Part E):</b><br/> - Agronomist with MFA session &lt;= 10 min authorizes fumigation orders<br/> - <i>Bedrock model NEVER authorizes fumigation or closes cases</i>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="465" width="490" x="1960" y="740" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="badge_D10" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dcebf7;strokeColor=#52708a;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#102a43;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" value="D10" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="26" width="52" x="2385" y="750" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b2_s5_card" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#8da2b5;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172b4d;fontSize=13.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=12;" value="<b><font size="4" color="#102a43">5. Failure Paths &amp; Recovery</font></b><br/><font color="#0b69a3"><b>Resilience &amp; Rollback (A18 sec 7, sec 10)</b></font><br/><br/>• <b>Per-Function Dead-Letter Queues (DLQ):</b><br/> - <code>infconfirmdlq</code>, <code>infverificationdlq</code>, <code>infestimatedlq</code><br/> - 5 retries with backoff; operator redrives without redeployment<br/> - Idempotent execution: retrying an invocation causes zero duplicates<br/><br/>• <b>CloudWatch Observability Hooks &amp; Alarms:</b><br/> - <code>&lt;prefix&gt;-pdn-alarm-&lt;fn&gt;-errors</code> &amp; throttles on alias<br/> - <code>InferenceFailed</code> custom metric &amp; <code>MissionsAwaitingResult</code><br/> - DLQ message age alarms trigger operational alerting<br/><br/>• <b>CodeDeploy Canary Rollback (&lt; 10 min target):</b><br/> - Canary alarm automatically reverts alias to previous version<br/><br/>• <b>Infrastructure Rollback (&lt; 2 hr target):</b><br/> - Revert commit via promotion for EventBridge rules, S3 policies, routing<br/><br/>• <b>Forward Correction (What CANNOT be rolled back):</b><br/> - <i>Uploaded objects:</i> Never deleted on rollback; buffer preserved<br/> - <i>Inference results:</i> Superseded by newer results (<code>function_version</code>)<br/> - <i>Activated polygons:</i> Replaced by activating previous polygon<br/> - <i>Quarantined objects:</i> Restored from versioned S3 with INC reference" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="465" width="490" x="2590" y="740" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_b1_s1_s2" edge="1" parent="1" source="b1_s1_card" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#0b69a3;strokeWidth=2.5;fontColor=#102a43;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="b1_s2_card" value="MQTT TLS 1.2+<br/>(mTLS port 8883/443)"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_b1_s2_s3" edge="1" parent="1" source="b1_s2_card" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#0b69a3;strokeWidth=2.5;fontColor=#102a43;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="b1_s3_card" value="Direct Put<br/>DynamoDB Action"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_b1_s3_s4" edge="1" parent="1" source="b1_s3_card" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#0b69a3;strokeWidth=2.5;fontColor=#102a43;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="b1_s4_card" value="SQS Action<br/>threshold_queue"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_b1_s4_s5" edge="1" parent="1" source="b1_s4_card" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#0b69a3;strokeWidth=2.5;fontColor=#102a43;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#c53030;" target="b1_s5_card" value="Evaluation failure<br/>DLQ &amp; Alarms"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_b2_s1_s2" edge="1" parent="1" source="b2_s1_card" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#0b69a3;strokeWidth=2.5;fontColor=#102a43;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="b2_s2_card" value="Pre-signed Upload<br/>(SHA-256 verified)"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_b2_s2_s3" edge="1" parent="1" source="b2_s2_card" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#0b69a3;strokeWidth=2.5;fontColor=#102a43;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="b2_s3_card" value="s3:ObjectCreated:*<br/>(Manifest trigger)"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_b2_s3_s4" edge="1" parent="1" source="b2_s3_card" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#0b69a3;strokeWidth=2.5;fontColor=#102a43;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="b2_s4_card" value="DynamoDB Streams<br/>EventBridge Pipe"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_b2_s4_s5" edge="1" parent="1" source="b2_s4_card" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#0b69a3;strokeWidth=2.5;fontColor=#102a43;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#c53030;" target="b2_s5_card" value="Inference failure<br/>DLQ &amp; Alarms"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
1. Field Sensor Nodes & Bearers
Triggers & Exit Protocols (A14, Connectivity sec 4)
• Two Sensor Node Classes per Farm:
- Crop node: 6 readings/day (temp, humidity, pH, NPK)
- Drying node: 24 readings/day while drying lot is open
• Secure Protocol & Device Identity (mTLS, D06):
- MQTT over TLS 1.2+ on port 8883 (or 443 with ALPN)
- Unique per-node X.509 client certificate from CSR (ASM-010)
- Zero static shared keys; operational revocation in IoT Core
• Store-and-Forward Buffer (No-Signal Resilience):
- Encrypted non-volatile ring buffer (>= 24 hours / 6 readings)
- On reconnect: live reading first, then drains oldest first
- PUBACK acknowledgement releases reading from buffer
• Bearers: LTE multi-network SIM; satellite for no-coverage (ASM-073)
• Path: Direct to IoT Core; bypasses centers and VPC (CL-TEL-04)

div.div:
2. Regional Ingestion & Topic Rule
AWS IoT Core & Pattern Module (ADR-003, B09)
• AWS IoT Core Regional Endpoint (us-east-1):
- Public ATS endpoint; terminates mTLS with device certificates
- Validates client certificates against IoT Thing Registry
- Topic: aroma/telemetry/<department>/<farm>/<node>
• Topic Rule (B09 Telemetry Pattern Module):
- SQL: SELECT *, timestamp() AS received_at FROM 'aroma/telemetry/#'
- Appends metadata: cert principal, client ID, source IP, timestamps
• Two Direct Rule Actions:
1. DynamoDB Action: Conditional put directly to telemetry table
2. SQS Action: Enqueues reading reference to threshold_queue
• Rule Error Action (Failure Path):
- Failed deliveries routed to SQS Error Queue for redrive (ASM-161)
- Rejected connection/publish logged to AWSIotLogsV2 at ERROR

div.div:
3. Primary Storage Target
Amazon DynamoDB Telemetry Store
• Target Table: telemetry (DynamoDB on-demand mode)
• Primary Keys:
- Partition Key: node_id (String)
- Sort Key: timestamp (Number, epoch milliseconds)
• Encryption & Protection (D06):
- Customer-managed KMS key (telemetry key)
- Deletion protection: prevent_destroy = true in Terraform
- Point-in-Time Recovery (PITR) enabled for continuous backups
• Retention & Compliance:
- 5-year retention enforced automatically by TTL attribute
- Audited Event 3: Stores cert principal, source IP, receive time (ASM-067)
• Scale: 3,600 readings/day peak; 3,600/min drain surge resilience

div.div:
4. Threshold Evaluation & Alerts
Event-Driven Processing (A14, A17)
• Buffer Queue: SQS threshold_queue (visibility timeout 300s)
• Threshold Function (AWS Lambda, live alias):
- Event Source Mapping with batch size 10 items
- Evaluates reading against versioned thresholds DynamoDB table
- Versioning Rule: Evaluated against threshold in force at
reading's original timestamp, not receive time (ASM-138)
- Idempotent conditional write prevents duplicate evaluations
• Episode Coalescing & Case Opening:
- Alerts open once per episode (node, variable), NOT per reading
- Persists crop_alert_raised to cases table; switches to precision mode
• Dual-Channel Farmer Notification Dispatch:
- Publishes to KMS-encrypted SNS alert_topic
- Lambda notification_dispatcher sends App Push & SMS
- Target: Delivered < 5 minutes for live reading (ASM-075)

div.div:
5. Failure Paths & Rollback
Resilience & Correction (A18 sec 6, sec 10)
• Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ) & Error Recovery:
- threshold_dlq captures failures after 5 attempts with backoff
- Unhandled IoT rule messages held in aroma-telemetry-error-queue
- Operator redrives messages without redeployment after fix
• CloudWatch Observability Hooks & Alarms:
- <prefix>-pdn-alarm-threshold-errors & throttles on alias
- <prefix>-pdn-alarm-threshold-dlq-age > 0
- ReadingNotPersisted metric & AWSIotLogsV2 error count
• CodeDeploy Canary Rollback (< 10 min target):
- Alarms during 10% canary automatically revert alias to previous version
• Forward Correction (What CANNOT be rolled back):
- Stored wrong attributes: Audited batch correction job
- Sent alerts / SMS: Dispatched correction notice on same channels
- Revoked certificates: Final action; re-enroll node with new CSR

div.div:
1. Ground Station Upload & Ingress
Contracted Drone Operator (ADR-002, A15, D04)
• Actor & Location:
- Contracted certified commercial drone operator (ADR-002)
- Collection center Soporte zone (IP 10.4x.2.10, VLAN 102)
- Or public link at municipal seat
• Upload Authorization (ASM-093):
- 15-minute S3 pre-signed upload URLs generated by API role
- Pre-signed URLs bound strictly to flight prefix and SHA-256 checksums
• Network Ingress Endpoints (Collection Center, D04):
- Ground station (10.4x.2.10) -> Center Firewall -> IPsec VPN tunnel ->
AWS Transit Gateway (D05) -> object_storage S3 interface endpoint
- Note: drone_object_ingress tier is RESERVED (ASM-140); active path
uses object_storage and application private interface endpoints
• Local Ground Station Buffer:
- Operator encrypted storage holds photos and records while offline
- Deleted ONLY upon platform persistence receipt (A15 sec 7)

div.div:
2. S3 Drone Object Bucket & Notifications
Object Ingestion & Audit Trail (A15, D06)
• Target Bucket: aroma-<env>-drone-objects (us-east-1)
• Security & Encryption Controls (CL-DRN-03, D06):
- S3 Block Public Access enabled across all four dimensions
- S3 Object Versioning enabled (protects against overwrites/deletions)
- Customer-managed KMS key (objects key)
- 5-year retention enforced by lifecycle rules
• Two-Phase Upload Sequence:
1. Flight objects uploaded: Orthomosaics, multispectral photos,
GPX flight tracks, telemetry logs
2. Flight manifest uploaded: JSON manifest detailing all files, checksums,
mission ID, timestamps, sensor calibration data
• S3 Event Notification Trigger:
- s3:ObjectCreated:* on manifest path invokes Lambda reception function
• CloudTrail S3 Data Events (Audited Event 4, ASM-067):
- Logs PutObject & CompleteMultipartUpload to audit trail in Security Account

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(141, 162, 181), rgb(85, 103, 120));

div.div:
3. Reception Function & Screening
Validation, Privacy & Receipts (A15, A17)
• AWS Lambda Reception Function (live alias):
- Invoked via S3 Event Notification upon manifest arrival
• Four Strict Validation Gates:
1. Manifest Verification: Validates SHA-256 hashes against active grant
2. Quarantine Gate: Any object outside grant or with invalid checksum
moved immediately to quarantine/ prefix
3. Privacy Screening (ASM-164, ASM-165):
- Images screened on ground station for human presence before upload
- Reception function moves flagged objects to restricted/person/
- Encrypted under customer-managed restricted KMS key
- Only screened crop images can ever leave Colombia to Bedrock!
4. Persistence Receipt: Emitted to ground station once all objects and
manifest are verified and linked (record_persisted)
• Mission Store Update:
- Writes flight record, mission state (record_persisted), and polygon
versions to DynamoDB missions table (records key, 5 years)

div.div:
4. EventBridge Routing & Bedrock
Event-Driven Inference Pattern (A17, B10)
• Event Decoupling Architecture:
- DynamoDB Streams captures record_persisted
- EventBridge Pipe routes events to custom aroma-drone-bus
• Four Mission-Type Rules & SQS Queues:
1. Delimitation: Rule -> SQS -> Delimitation Lambda (activates polygon)
2. Confirmation: Rule -> infconfirmqueue (DLQ: infconfirmdlq) -> Lambda
3. Estimation: Rule -> infestimatequeue (DLQ: infestimatedlq) -> Lambda
4. Verification: Rule -> infverificationqueue (DLQ: infverificationdlq) -> Lambda
• Amazon Bedrock Inference (us-east-1):
- Calls vision foundation model (Amazon Nova Pro) by model ID
- Packages embed zero-shot prompt & schema (prompt_version, ASM-179)
- Persists result: timestamp, confidence, function_version, source object
• Strict Human Governance (ADR-002, Part E):
- Agronomist with MFA session <= 10 min authorizes fumigation orders
- Bedrock model NEVER authorizes fumigation or closes cases

div.div:
5. Failure Paths & Recovery
Resilience & Rollback (A18 sec 7, sec 10)
• Per-Function Dead-Letter Queues (DLQ):
- infconfirmdlq, infverificationdlq, infestimatedlq
- 5 retries with backoff; operator redrives without redeployment
- Idempotent execution: retrying an invocation causes zero duplicates
• CloudWatch Observability Hooks & Alarms:
- <prefix>-pdn-alarm-<fn>-errors & throttles on alias
- InferenceFailed custom metric & MissionsAwaitingResult
- DLQ message age alarms trigger operational alerting
• CodeDeploy Canary Rollback (< 10 min target):
- Canary alarm automatically reverts alias to previous version
• Infrastructure Rollback (< 2 hr target):
- Revert commit via promotion for EventBridge rules, S3 policies, routing
• Forward Correction (What CANNOT be rolled back):
- Uploaded objects: Never deleted on rollback; buffer preserved
- Inference results: Superseded by newer results (function_version)
- Activated polygons: Replaced by activating previous polygon
- Quarantined objects: Restored from versioned S3 with INC reference
